'''Alberto Diaspro''' (born 7 April 1959 in [[Genoa, Italy]]) is an Italian scientist.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://topitalianscientists.org/tis/4511/Alberto_Diaspro_-_Top_Italian_Scientist_in_Physics | title=Top Italian Scientists }}</ref> He received his doctoral degree in [[electronic engineering]] from the university of [[Genoa, Italy]], in 1983. He is full professor in [[applied physics]] at [[university of Genoa]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.difi.unige.it/en|title=Alberto Giovanni Diaspro|website=Dipartimento di Fisica}}</ref> He is research director of Nanoscopy [[Italian Institute of Technology]].<ref>[https://www.iit.it/people/alberto-diaspro Alberto Diaspro - Research Director - Optical Nanoscopy - Nanophysics - Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia (IIT)<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> Alberto Diaspro is President of the Italian [[biophysical]] society [[SIBPA]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.difi.unige.it/it/news/2021/07/14/alberto-diaspro-e-stato-eletto-presidente-della-societa-italiana-di-biofisica-pura | title=Alberto Diaspro è stato eletto Presidente della Società Italiana di Biofisica Pura e Applicata }}</ref> In 2022 he received the [[Gregorio Weber]] Award for excellence in [[fluorescence]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://iss.com/about/news/Alberto-Diaspro-Weber-Award.html | title=Honoring Prof. Alberto Diaspro &#124; Weber Award &#124; News &#124; ISS }}</ref>
